energy_bins_note: energy and depth tallies have n + 2 entries: underflow, n bins, overflow

charged_energy_loss.meaning: energy lost in the scoring volume by particle (e-, e+) and type (collision, radiative)

depth_edep.meaning: central-axis depth scan, energy deposited within depthRadius

edep_by_parent.meaning: energy deposited in the scoring volume by parent photon category (index 4: unknown) and depositing particle (gamma, e-, e+)

electron_angular.meaning: e-, sum w*L by cos(theta) to beam axis (pre-step direction)

electron_fluence.meaning: e-, all, sum w*L by energy bin

electron_fluence_by_parent.meaning: e- by parent photon: primary(0), non-primary(1), unknown(2)

electron_fluence_delta.meaning: e- created by charged particles (delta rays and descendants)

initial_cos.meaning: sum w by process, parent primary(0)/non-primary(1), cos(theta) to beam axis

initial_count.meaning: sum w by process, parent category, particle

initial_energy.meaning: sum w*T by process, parent category, particle

initial_spectrum.meaning: sum w by process, parent photon category, particle (e-, e+), T bin

interaction_energy_transfer.meaning: sum w*E_tr by category and process

interaction_incident_energy.meaning: sum w*E_in by category and process

interaction_spectrum.meaning: sum w by process and incident photon energy bin

interactions.meaning: sum w by incident photon category and process

photon_angular.meaning: sum w*L by photon category and cos(theta) to beam axis

photon_fluence.meaning: sum w*L by photon category and energy bin

positron_fluence.meaning: e+, sum w*L by energy bin
